entries.text: A materialized view's build takes the same route decision a query with its definition takes: a definition one source reads whole runs at that source, on any engine kind, and only its result rows come back; they are staged beside the view's table and every build step reads them there.

entries.text: A calendar can declare the local time its day closes at, in its time zone (an 18:00 close of business in Europe/London); a day then runs from the previous day's close to its own, every grain's boundary moves with it, and a daily view refreshes at the close.

entries.text: A table or a view is bitemporal by mapping three values to its columns: business_key (what identifies the same thing across versions), valid_time (the date the business gives the record: when it was agreed, booked or took effect) and recorded_time (when this version was entered or changed).
